# License sources

The files in this directory reproduce the license text shipped in the exact primary distributions identified in `../DEPENDENCIES.md`. They are kept as standalone files so the notices can be included with binary distributions of UMIS.

- `Adobe-XMP-Toolkit-SDK-LICENSE`: Adobe XMP Toolkit SDK v2025.03 root `LICENSE` (BSD 3-Clause).
- `Expat-COPYING`: Expat 2.5.0 root `COPYING` (MIT-style license).
- `zlib-LICENSE`: zlib 1.2.13 root `LICENSE`.
- `CMake-Copyright.txt`: CMake 3.23.2 application documentation `Copyright.txt`; CMake is used only to generate the build and is not linked into the XCFramework.
- `RSA-MD5-NOTICE`: required notice for the RSA Data Security, Inc. MD5 implementation bundled in the pinned Adobe source and compiled into the static libraries.
- `Expat-SipHash-CC0-NOTICE`: the CC0 identification attached to the SipHash implementation compiled from Expat 2.5.0.

Do not rewrite or translate these upstream texts. Human-readable provenance and hashes are maintained in `../DEPENDENCIES.md`.
